Proposed command cargo test --offline --locked -p lamp-voice --lib --no-run --message-format=json-render-diagnostics. No full suite/gate and no automatic retry.

environment.target: /private/tmp/tests-codex-1569-target only with explicit exclusive CPU/target grant
environment.permissions: require_escalated for authorized Unix/loopback fixture sockets
environment.architecture: Assert actual rustc host x86_64-apple-darwin and retained Mach-O x86_64 executable; physical hardware/translation remains unverified.

before_each_case: Verify exact source arm, complete source map/modes, only owned diagnostic deltas and unchanged original assertions.
Verify compiler-artifact path/hash and complete --list inventory matches the frozen arm; exactly one matching case; bind rustc/cargo/profile/features.
Verify executable SHA before and after; use an exclusive execution marker; retain command/cwd/env/start/finish/exit/raw streams and all outputs.
stop_conditions: Any compile/format preflight error, source/artifact mismatch, invalid inventory, socket permission failure, unexpected setup panic, crash, outer timeout, trace overflow or failed forced-boundary validation stops remaining execution after bounded owned-group cleanup. Retain attempted/invalid/unrun distinctly.
A complete normal case failure at an original scenario assertion is retained as an observation; it does not authorize a retry or fix.

SIGINT/SIGTERM/exception must terminate and reap only the owned verified process group within a bounded cleanup, then restore exact source bytes/modes in finally. No orphan or arbitrary PID signalling.
Never add notice/is_late/source_gone/sources calls; never alter production clock, freshness, assertions or fixture deadlines to obtain the expected outcome.
external_cap_basis: Privacy original read loop bounds plus ten attempts in each of two arms;60 s is external emergency containment. Search has two scenario arms, each with five child readiness waits bounded30 s, scope24 s and original supervisor cleanup;420 s covers that existing worst-case composition plus setup. These external caps do not change any fixture watchdog.
interpretation: Normal traces address which boundary an observed execution reaches. Forced arms are attribution/boundary controls only: they force elapsed time after a chosen event and cannot establish why the earlier unscheduled failure occurred. No original failure is overwritten or waived. Search pause proves only the watchdog/cleanup boundary after fixture publication; it does not prove coordinator consumption or recreate the original semantic progress.
search_boundary_trigger: After fixture publishes push (without observing coordinator consumption). The hold is inside the peer pump before the coordinator resumes; it is not a reproduction of the earlier trace that already recorded search_pushed.
